mechanism: Amitriptyline may impair glucose metabolism and increase hypoglycemic risk through anticholinergic effects and potential CNS-mediated alterations in glucose homeostasis, while also causing weight gain that complicates insulin requirements.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; amitriptyline may potentiate insulin effects or cause unpredictable glycemic control—adjust insulin dosing as needed and educate patient on hypoglycemia awareness.
